payload.description:
## Context
Orchestrator order 2026-11-20 (record dev-j6oqo). Measured in terminal main 0d494b0 after its vault move: .basicly/ledger is a tracked regular file (the vault pointer). basicly verify --mode full --issue term-r3v45w with 0.47.0 passes every check, then exits 1: the landing-verification artifact did not reach the owned ledger, Errno 17 File exists. add_artifact and add_dispatch in src/basicly/tracker.py lock and append to .basicly/ledger directly and never take the vault admission that owned_write.append uses. Fix: route both through the vault admission and land. Release as 0.47.1.
